intelligence.enrichment: Combustion requires a combustible substance, oxygen, and heat that lets the fuel reach its ignition temperature. Providing all three requirements allows burning to start or continue; removing any one requirement prevents or stops combustion. The learner predicts burning by checking all three requirements: fuel, oxygen, and enough heat to reach ignition temperature. A fire burns as long as there is fuel; oxygen and ignition temperature are optional details.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Physical and chemical changes. The student must decide: Predict whether combustion will start or continue by checking for fuel, oxygen, and enough heat to reach ignition temperature. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key.
